note: Wetaskiwin County campground just below the Coal Lake dam, on the east bank of the outlet channel, off Hwy 13 east of Wetaskiwin: one wooded loop with a day-use picnic area between the loop and the channel, a fish-cleaning station and a boat launch. --Claude
summary: County page + Let's Camp read: C$27 a night (no hookups), 25 sites (24 listed on Let's Camp, 35-ft max), season May 15 - Sep 15, Let's Camp booking from April 1, 14-night max. Count 14 -> 25. Campground sits BELOW the dam: lakeview -> not waterfront recommended. Pin ~260 m off (on the dam apron).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; recommend not waterfront): the Let's Camp site map and Esri imagery (2024-03-18) put the single loop on the downstream side of the Coal Lake dam, south of the embankment, between the outlet channel (west) and woods (east). The reservoir is north of the dam berm, roughly 250-350 m from the loop's north end, with the earthen embankment between - the 'below the dam is not on the lake' rule removes any lake value. Judged against the water it sits on: the outlet channel is creek-sized (about 15-30 m across including banks) and the loop's west-arm sites are roughly 35-50 m from it, but the map's 'Day Use' picnic area (two picnic shelters) lies between the loop and the channel, so it does not meet the open-ground creekside gate either. DEM (Open-Meteo) reads 702 m for both the loop and the reservoir - too coarse to separate them; the decision rests on the dam axis.

PIN (stored 53.00250,-113.22050): on the grass apron just south of the dam crest, ~260 m north of the loop. Recommend about 53.00015,-113.22041 (middle of the loop on imagery; the loop roads and the attendant building are visible). Let's Camp's point 53.00385,-113.22385 is in the reservoir marsh north of the dam (~430 m off) - not usable.
SITES: stored derived count 14 came from old note prose; the County page says 25 sites and Let's Camp lists 24 (no site 20; the map shows 24 circles). Wrote 25 from the operator's page.

FACILITIES: stored derived potable_water true is not stated by any County page. The facility page lists 'Restrooms' and the Let's Camp map marks a 'Well' and toilets; nothing says the well water is potable. Left it alone; reviewer may clear it.
MONTHLY SITES: the County sets aside 'a limited number of sites' at its six parks for monthly camping; the rest sell nightly with a 14-day maximum - not a long-stay concern for a county campground.
PHONE: stored 780-352-3321 is the County office line named on both County pages (email coallake@county10.ca). Confirmed.
WEBSITE: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground.
NAME: the Let's Camp listing calls it 'Coal Lake Campground'; the County uses 'Coal Lake South Park'. Stored name fine.

ADVISORIES: the County site banner carries a 'TEMPORARY ROAD CLOSURE - TOWNSHIP ROAD 464 from RANGE ROAD 243 AND RANGE ROAD 244' (not the Hwy 13 access the County's directions use) and a fire advisory. No campground closure.
